tokens.name: readout-line

tokens.name: changed
tokens.usage: 'Changed recently' frequency badge text. Alias --chg.

tokens.usage: 'Changed recently' badge background. Alias --chgc.

tokens.usage: Healthy source, sent, saved. Alias --ok.

tokens.usage: Error banner and destructive button background. Alias --errc.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information icons and toasts. Alias --info.
